英文即时消息: Hi [Name]! Thanks for messaging us 💕 We make lash extensions, tweezers and hair products. What are you looking for today?
中文对照: 你好 [Name]！感谢留言 💕 我们做嫁接睫毛、镊子和假发产品。今天想了解什么呢？

标题: 了解客户类型｜确认客户身份
英文即时消息: Are you a lash artist, a salon, or do you resell lashes in your own shop? That helps me suggest the right trays and quantities.
中文对照: 请问您是美睫师、美容院，还是自己开店零售？这样我能推荐合适的款式和数量。

英文即时消息: Here is our latest catalog: [Catalog link]. Prices are on page 2. Let me know which items catch your eye!
中文对照: 这是我们最新的目录：[Catalog link]。价格在第 2 页，看中哪款告诉我！

标题: 假发需求｜确认发型长度
英文即时消息: For the wigs, which texture do you need (straight / body wave / deep wave), what length, and which lace (13x4 frontal or 5x5 closure)?
中文对照: 假发方面，请问需要什么纹理（直发 / 大波浪 / 深波浪）、多长，以及哪种蕾丝（13x4 frontal 还是 5x5 closure）？

英文即时消息: Thanks for your message! We're offline now (Beijing time 9:00–18:00) and will reply first thing tomorrow.
中文对照: 感谢留言！我们现在下班了（北京时间 9:00–18:00），明天一早回复您。

英文即时消息: Our [Product] trays are $[Price] each for 1–49 pcs, and $[Bulk price] each from 50 pcs. Free shipping over $[Free shipping amount].
中文对照: [Product] 1–49 盒每盒 $[Price]，50 盒起每盒 $[Bulk price]。满 $[Free shipping amount] 包邮。

英文即时消息: I understand! Our lashes use premium PBT fiber, hold their curl after 30+ washes, and every tray is checked by hand. Most artists waste fewer lashes, so each set actually costs less.
中文对照: 理解！我们的睫毛用优质 PBT 纤维，洗 30 次以上不掉卷，每盒都人工检查。很多美睫师反馈浪费更少，算下来每套成本反而更低。

英文即时消息: Since it's your first order, I can give you [Discount]% off if you order today 😊
中文对照: 因为是首单，今天下单可以给您 [Discount]% 折扣 😊

英文即时消息: Let me confirm your order: [Order details]. Total: $[Total amount], shipping to [Address]. Is everything correct?
中文对照: 和您确认一下订单：[Order details]。合计 $[Total amount]，寄往 [Address]。信息都对吗？
使用备注: 发送前核实金额和地址

英文即时消息: You can pay by PayPal, bank transfer or Alibaba Trade Assurance. Which is easiest for you?
中文对照: 可以用 PayPal、银行转账或阿里巴巴信保付款。哪种对您最方便？

英文即时消息: Payment received, thank you [Name]! Your order goes into packing today and I'll send the tracking number once it ships.
中文对照: 已收到款项，谢谢 [Name]！今天就安排打包，发货后发您单号。
